judgments.reason: The dataset README says it is converted from the data released with Nejedly et al. 2020 Scientific Data (same DOI). The paper's title and abstract describe this multicenter iEEG graphoelement clip dataset, including the St. Anne's (FNUSA) site.
judgments.paper_title: Multicenter intracranial EEG dataset for classification of graphoelements and artifactual signals

judgments.reason: Figshare record 'BIDS_FNUSA' by Worrell, Brinkmann, Kremen, Nejedly et al. is the authors' own deposit of the same FNUSA iEEG data described in Nejedly 2020 Sci Data.
